study type: Prospective cohort study (current phase) compared to a historic cohort
outcome: Proportion of women reaching the minimal inhibitory concentration (MIC) of cefazolin (8 μg/mL)
cohort: 28 obese women (BMI >30 kg/m2) receiving 3g cefazolin for cesarean delivery (current phase) and 29 women from a historical cohort who received 2g cefazolin
finding: Increasing the prophylactic cefazolin dose from 2g to 3g in obese women undergoing cesarean delivery resulted in higher adipose tissue concentrations and a greater proportion of women achieving the target MIC.
